title: 6. Key Features of the Indian Constitution (RRB Focus)

blocks.content: The Constitution of India is the longest written constitution of any sovereign country in the world.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Indian Constitution is the longest and most detailed written constitution of any sovereign nation in the world.
It combines rigidity and flexibility, allowing simple majorities for minor changes and special majorities for constitutional amendments under Article 368.
It establishes a quasi-federal system of governance with a strong central bias during national emergencies.
Key provisions were borrowed from multiple global constitutions, such as Fundamental Rights from the USA and Directive Principles from Ireland.

rows: Single central government supremacy in emergencies
Single constitution for both Centre and States
Division of powers between Centre and States

items: RRB NTPC and Group D exams frequently ask about the constitutional sources (e.g., DPSP from Ireland, Fundamental Rights from USA, Parliamentary system from UK).
Eighth Schedule of the Constitution currently recognizes 22 official languages.
Article 368 details the procedure and powers of Parliament to amend the Constitution.
